communityContributions.status: Conflict, uncertainty and applicability handling complete
communityContributions.principle: Owner contributions should make B-Atlas smarter, not noisier.
communityContributions.prototypeStorage: Contribution records, normalized knowledge items and evidence relationships remain browser-local pending a shared moderation backend.
communityContributions.coverageExpansionPolicy: A proposed manufacturer requires only a manufacturer name. A proposed model requires only manufacturer and model name. All other details remain optional; exact canonical duplicates are blocked and redirected toward correction/contribution.
communityContributions.documentPolicy: External document links may be submitted directly for review. Uploaded PDFs require a rights declaration; uncertain rights are accepted for evidence/review but do not imply republication permission.
communityContributions.resourcePolicy: Useful resources are URL-based and attach to an existing canonical model for later Guide Owner Resources integration.
communityContributions.conflictPolicy: Evidence relationships are supports, contradicts, or qualifies. Contradictions remain visible and force a conflicting-information state rather than being flattened into consensus.
communityContributions.privacyPolicy: Collect only contribution content plus optional attribution/contact; no account required.
communityContributions.antiAbusePolicy: Static prototype uses browser-local rate limiting, honeypot and minimum dwell time; server-side challenge/rate enforcement is required when shared submission transport is added.
communityContributions.uploadSafety: Photos are privacy-cleaned by browser re-encoding where decodable. PDFs are size/type restricted but require server malware scanning before shared ingestion.
